intro.speaker: ZP-SYS
intro.subject: Emergency power restored. Pod 04 seal released. Occupant {iteration}: revival complete. Remain in position until motor function is confirmed.
intro.visitor: Perimeter sensor 12: heat signature detected. Unregistered personnel. Remain in position. Awaiting identification.

perimeter.speaker: ZP-SYS
perimeter.subject: Perimeter lighting: manual control available at this station. Reserve power limit: two lamps at a time. Heat signature detected on the perimeter.

whiteout.visitor: Whiteout. Nothing is visible past arm's length. Posts stand in the snow, each one painted with a symbol.

returning.speaker: PROCTOR
returning.text: You left last time. You came back. You always come back.

skipper_welcome.speaker: PROCTOR
skipper_welcome.text: Welcome back. You have skipped {skipped} of my lines so far. I count them. Counting is very nearly the only thing I enjoy.

intake_complete.speaker: ZP-SYS
intake_complete.subject: Outer door cycle complete. Perimeter contact lost. Intake logged. Occupant register updated.

calibration_done.speaker: ZP-SYS
calibration_done.subject: Calibration complete. Results within expected range. Proceed to chamber 02.

body_found.subject: Someone from outside. An orange jacket, snow still in the seams, the doors come down across the legs. Not one of the facility's. Whoever they were, they almost made it in.

records_warning.speaker: ZP-SYS
records_warning.subject: Caution: acoustic unit active in Records. Personnel approaching. Radio silence advised.
records_warning.visitor: Caution: acoustic unit active in Records. The unit tracks active radios. Switch radios off before entry.

chamber02_done.speaker: ZP-SYS
chamber02_done.subject: Release code accepted. Chamber 02 exit unsealed.

plant_online.speaker: ZP-SYS
plant_online.subject: Generator 4 online. Sector 4 power restored.
plant_online.visitor: Breakers closed. Sector 4 power restored. Heating, lighting and doors returning by section.

power_returning.speaker: ZP-SYS
power_returning.subject: Sector 4 power returning by section. Sealed doors in this sector are now operable.
power_returning.visitor: Heating restored. Lighting restored by section. Sealed doors in this sector are now operable. Lower levels accessible via stairwell C.

went_down_subject.subject: The lift drops for a long time. It stops twice, at floors with no buttons. Then the cable lets go.

went_down_visitor.visitor: The stairs go down further than the building is tall. Somewhere above, very close, a lift goes by.

plant_vented.speaker: ZP-SYS
plant_vented.text: Pressure vented. Restart sequence aborted. Reinitialise restart sequence.

released.speaker: ZP-SYS
released.visitor: Release code accepted. Intake 2 cleared to proceed.

airlock_sealed.speaker: ZP-SYS
airlock_sealed.visitor: Outer door sealed. Welcome to Zero Point. Internal temperature below safe limits. Proceed to the nearest heated area.

cell_monitor.speaker: ZP-SYS
cell_monitor.subject: Maintenance access code on display. Relay code to maintenance personnel.

keypad1.speaker: ZP-SYS
keypad1.visitor: Access code required. Code is displayed at the occupant monitor, cell 04.

monitor_first.speaker: ZP-SYS
monitor_first.visitor: Notice: this display is encoded for occupant use only.

power_restored.speaker: ZP-SYS
power_restored.subject: East wing power restored. Cell 04 unlocked.
power_restored.visitor: East wing power and heating restored.

storage.speaker: ZP-SYS
storage.subject: Supply room 4B. Inventory not verified since last audit. Distribute supplies as required.

survival_enemy.speaker: ZP-SYS
survival_enemy.visitor: Caution: maintenance unit 07 active. Unit not responding to commands. Keep clear.

frozen_door.visitor: The bulkhead is frozen solid. The heater beside it is dead, its cell slot empty.

heater_on.speaker: ZP-SYS
heater_on.text: Heater online. Bulkhead 4 thaw in progress. Thaw cycle {iteration}.

p3_room.speaker: ZP-SYS
p3_room.subject: Calibration chamber 01. Reference sequence displayed off-site. Enter sequence at the console.

p3_solved.speaker: ZP-SYS
p3_solved.subject: Sequence accepted. Reference display not in line of sight. Anomaly logged.
p3_solved.visitor: Sequence accepted. Remote entry confirmed. Anomaly logged.

corridor_open.speaker: ZP-SYS
corridor_open.subject: Bulkhead open. Proceed to the intake wing.
corridor_open.visitor: Bulkhead open. Proceed to the occupant wing.

radio_unused.speaker: PROCTOR
radio_unused.text: Neither of you has touched the radio. And yet you keep agreeing with each other. Who are you talking to?

reunion.speaker: ZP-SYS
reunion.text: Occupants present: 2. Test {iteration}... correction. Headcount: 2. Logged.

frozen_body.speaker: ZP-SYS
frozen_body.subject: Cold storage, unit 04. Contents: 1 occupant.
frozen_body.visitor: Cold storage, unit 04. Contents: 1 occupant. Identity unconfirmed.

elevator.speaker: ZP-SYS
elevator.text: Service lift descending. Emergency systems entering low-power mode.

cold_warning.visitor: The fingers have gone numb. The cold is no longer outside.

mic_blocked.speaker: PROCTOR
mic_blocked.text: Your microphone is closed. You can keep me from hearing you. You cannot keep me from reading you.

mic_blocked_again.speaker: PROCTOR
mic_blocked_again.text: Microphone closed again. That makes {mic_sessions}. You think silence makes you harder to study. It makes you easier.

friendly_fire.speaker: PROCTOR
friendly_fire.text: Oh. You can do that. Do it again; I would like to know whether they bleed.

rushing.speaker: PROCTOR
rushing.text: You are moving faster than I can talk. I will assume that is enthusiasm and not contempt. I will be wrong, but I will assume it.

skipping.speaker: PROCTOR
skipping.text: You skipped that. And that. I wrote every one of these lines myself, {iteration} times. But no, go on. You're busy.

collapse.visitor: Everything goes white. Then the hum of a lamp, close by, and the cold again.
